_about: Every number this episode shows or says, with its source and the day it was checked. Re-check each before a render that will be published; the narration in public/audio/phrases says these numbers too, so a change here means a re-voiced line.

modalStarterCredit.note: modal.com/pricing: Starter plan, $0 + compute, $30 a month free credits; a payment method must be on file (modal.com/docs/guide/billing)

prices.note: What Modal billed for a measured batch, idle time included: 3 LTX-2.3 clips (1024x576, 121 frames) $0.334, so $0.111 each; 10 Qwen3-TTS lines in one call $0.059, so $0.006 each; FLUX.2 images in bursts of four $0.038 and $0.047, so $0.0095 to $0.012 each. The figures here round up. A clip, line or image made on its own costs more: every call is followed by a minute of idle GPU that is billed.
prices.source: uv run --extra modal modal billing report --for today -r h --json, the hour of the batch, per app. Not tools/video_job.py PRICES or a tool's 'Est. cost' line: those count the seconds of the call only, and came out about a quarter low for clips and a third low for images
prices.elevenLabsNote: The toolkit author's own plan: ElevenLabs Starter, $5 a month, which voiced this episode (Conal, 2026-11-16)

bill.note: The toolkit author's Modal workspace, every app including research spikes; modal billing report
bill.source: uv run --extra modal modal billing report --start <month> --end <month> --resolution d --json, summed
bill.projectsSource: projects/ with an out/*.mp4 rendered 2026-11-01 to 2026-11-15, prototypes excluded
